Songcraft Polymorphic Resonance (Rank 1) Abyssal Charges 2 Range: Caster only Instant 30sec Cooldown Effect Granted Polymorphic Resonance Grants immortality to allies in a 15m radius. When subjected to fatal damage, affected allies transform into animals and recover a small amount of HP. Affected characters cannot gain the Immortality effect again for a while. For up to 25 seconds, grants temporary immortality to allies within a 15m radius. When subjected to fatal damage, affected allies instead transform into animals and recover a small amount of Health, becoming temporarily immune to all debuffs. This spell has an initial duration of 3 seconds, and consumes any additional Abyssal Charges over time to extend the duration 3 seconds per charge. If cast while at 6 Abyssal Charges, it has an initial duration of 5 seconds and each extra charge extends the duration 5 seconds instead. Effect ends when no charges remain. Lucius Bards of Erenor look to Lucius, a bawdy playwright and bard with a penchant for romance. A symbol of romance, he would later become Anir, the god of art. Songcraft is a support skill tree built around Perform skills. Each song is an ongoing spell that buffs the whole party with movement speed, defense, damage or debuff protection, and the tree adds healing, mana restoration, charms and a stun. Its own damage is limited, so it is usually paired with trees that deal damage. Lucius

Bards of Erenor look to Lucius, a bawdy playwright and bard with a penchant for romance. A symbol of romance, he would later become Anir, the god of art.

Songcraft is a support skill tree built around Perform skills. Each song is an ongoing spell that buffs the whole party with movement speed, defense, damage or debuff protection, and the tree adds healing, mana restoration, charms and a stun. Its own damage is limited, so it is usually paired with trees that deal damage.
